support.label: Game Support
support.title: How and Where to Properly Contact Game Support
support.description: How to properly contact Magic Rampage support and what information to include.

paragraphs: If you encounter a problem in the game that you cannot solve yourself, you can contact support. To help them resolve your issue faster, it is important to write your request clearly and provide the necessary information.

sections.title: What Can You Contact Support About?
paragraphs: You can contact support, for example, if:
list: You encounter a technical error or bug
Game items, rewards, or other progress have disappeared
You have problems with purchases or in-game payments
You have problems with your account
You encounter another situation that you cannot solve yourself

sections.title: How to Write a Support Request
paragraphs: It is recommended to contact support in English or Portuguese. Your message should be brief and clear: describe the problem first, then add the important details.
list: A detailed description of the problem
If necessary — when and under what circumstances the problem occurred
sections.highlight: For example, instead of simply writing: “An item disappeared.” It is better to explain which item disappeared, when it happened, and what you were doing before it happened.

paragraphs: The more accurately you describe the situation, the easier it will be for a support representative to understand the problem and help you.

sections.title: The Main Points
sections.highlight: It is recommended to write your request in English or Portuguese, provide your nickname and Magic ID, and calmly describe the problem in detail. You do not need to write a long message — the important thing is that your request clearly explains what happened and what kind of help you need.

sections.title: Where to Send Your Request?
paragraphs: You can contact game support in two ways:
list: through support.magicrampage.com
sections.highlight: If you contact support through the website, be sure to provide your email address so that the support team can send you a response.

paragraphs: A response from support usually arrives within 4 business days, so there is no need to send several identical requests in a row — it is better to wait for a response.
